subject.title: Windows QuickStart defaults first chat to paid Anthropic model without credit warning

question: What should Windows/QuickStart do when Anthropic is selected and the first-run default is an Opus model that may require paid API credit?
rationale: Source shows the behavior is still present, but changing the default model or adding a billing preflight is a product policy choice with provider-cost and onboarding implications.

options.title: Warn or preflight before hatch
options.body: Keep explicit Anthropic selection but add a pre-hatch billing/credit warning or readiness check plus clearer first-chat billing failure copy.

options.title: Use a safer first-run default
options.body: Change QuickStart’s Anthropic first-run default or force explicit model confirmation so beginners do not start on Opus unexpectedly.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Document that Anthropic QuickStart may start on Opus and require paid credit, accepting the onboarding support burden.

recommendation.title: Warn or preflight before hatch
recommendation.body: Keep explicit Anthropic selection but add a pre-hatch billing/credit warning or readiness check plus clearer first-chat billing failure copy.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant default-model and setup-wizard history most directly points to this owner path.
